_about: Network modes and services for astrid-openshell.sh. Users pick them with `astrid-openshell.sh services`; nobody edits this file to use Astrid. To add a service, add an entry here (hosts, binaries, optional credential or setup) and test it with `astrid-openshell.sh check`.

locked.title: Locked
locked.summary: no network except the services you turn on

dev.title: Dev sources, read-only
dev.summary: also download from PyPI, npm, GitHub, Hugging Face and Remotion's browser host (no uploads or pushes)

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT plan via Astrid's agent
chatgpt.summary: Astrid's own agent (omp, a Pi derivative) on your ChatGPT plan; sign in once with a device code
chatgpt.login_note: Astrid's agent opens. Type /login, choose a ChatGPT option and open the link it shows in your browser. The browser option calls back to localhost:1455, which is forwarded into the sandbox while you sign in; the "headless/device" option uses a code instead. Pick a model with /model, then quit with /exit.
chatgpt.logout_note: Astrid's agent opens. Type /logout, choose the ChatGPT account, then quit with /exit.
chatgpt.note: Turn on device code login first: ChatGPT > Settings > Security. The sign-in tokens are stored inside the sandbox (~/.omp/agent/agent.db).

codex.title: ChatGPT plan via Codex CLI
codex.summary: chat with the Codex agent on your ChatGPT plan; sign in once with a device code
codex.note: Turn on device code login first: ChatGPT > Settings > Security. The sign-in tokens are stored inside the sandbox (~/.codex/auth.json).
codex.login_note: Open the link Codex shows in your browser and enter the code.

huggingface.title: Hugging Face
huggingface.summary: download models and datasets; a token (optional) unlocks gated models

credential.prompt: Hugging Face token (read-only is enough; Enter to skip for public models only)

openai.summary: Astrid's own agent on api.openai.com (pay per token)

credential.prompt: OpenAI API key (use a throwaway key with a spend cap)

anthropic.summary: Astrid's own agent on api.anthropic.com (pay per token)

credential.prompt: Anthropic API key (use a throwaway key with a spend cap)

credential.prompt: OpenRouter API key (use a throwaway key with a spend cap)

comfyui.title: ComfyUI on this machine
comfyui.summary: Astrid's local generation runs on your ComfyUI; its output folder is shared read-only
comfyui.note: The sandbox may call ComfyUI's core API (queue, upload, history, view) on that port only; ComfyUI-Manager, settings writes and custom-node routes are refused. Anything a custom node can do when queued, the agent can do, so prefer a ComfyUI instance with only the nodes you trust. Turning this on recreates the sandbox (the shared folder is fixed at creation).
